name: publicWeb_getMyRuns
description: The app's Runs tab for a signed-in web member (E9.F7.S8), mirroring what the phone holds after hcapp_syncUserData: every run of the kennels they follow (120 days back to 365 days ahead), every live kennel's runs in the ten-day global window either side of now, and their own RSVP'd (RsvpState >= 2), attended (AttendenceState >= 20) or hared runs within the same 120 / 365-day bounds. Only visible, live runs of live kennels. IsPast follows the app's 6-hour rule (query_runs.dart showAsPastEvent). Rows are the publicWeb_getGlobalRuns shape plus the My* columns the run card needs, the activity counts and the caller's preference bitfield. Auth: HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 111, @param NULL); scoped to the token's user. Read-only.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: The browser's HC.Device id. No SQL default.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived token signed for this SP (ValidateAppAuth spNumber 111). No SQL default.

rowsets.name: AuthErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: On a ValidateAppAuth failure: { success = 0, errorCode, errorType } then the detail at index 1; the SP RETURNs.
Error detail after the AuthErrorEnvelope (errorId, errorType, errorCode, errorTitle, errorUserMessage, errorProc).

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: On success, before the data rowsets: { success = 1, errorCode = NULL, errorType = NULL }.

rowsets.name: Runs
rowsets.description: On success: one row per run in the window, ORDER BY EventStartDatetimeGmt ASC.

columns.name: PublicEventId
columns.description: HC.Event.PublicEventId — public-facing event UUID for deep-links.

columns.name: EventName
columns.description: HC.Event.EventName — event name. Table column NOT NULL.

columns.name: EventStartDatetime
columns.description: CAST(Event.EventStartDatetime AS datetime2(7)) — timezone offset stripped. Client receives local time without UTC offset. Use KennelIANATimezone to reconstruct the offset if needed.

columns.name: PackOffMinutes
columns.description: Effective pack-off (E3.F1.S6): minutes after the gather — the run's own, else the kennel's default; NULL = the pack leaves at the gather.

columns.name: EventEndDatetime
columns.description: CAST(Event.EventEndDatetime AS datetime2(7)) — timezone offset stripped. NULL when no end time is set.

columns.name: EventStartDatetimeGmt
columns.description: HC.Event.EventStartDatetimeGmt — the run's true UTC instant, maintained by trigger from Kennel → City → Timezone. The filter and sort key. Use it with KennelIANATimezone for display.

columns.name: KennelIANATimezone
columns.description: IANA zone of the kennel's city (territory '001' mapping, else MIN). NULL when unmapped.

columns.name: EventTypeName
columns.description: DomainValues.EventThemeType.EventEnumName — human-readable event theme type (e.g. 'Red Dress Run'). NULL when Event.ThemeRunType has no matching DomainValues row (ThemeRunType = 0 = normal run).

columns.name: EventPriceForMembers
columns.description: COALESCE(Event.EventPriceForMembers, Kennel.DefaultEventPriceForMembers) — event-level price overrides kennel default. NULL when neither is set. Never NULL: the kennel defaults are NOT NULL.

columns.name: EventPriceForNonMembers
columns.description: COALESCE(Event.EventPriceForNonMembers, Kennel.DefaultEventPriceForNonMembers) — event-level price overrides kennel default. NULL when neither is set. Never NULL: the kennel defaults are NOT NULL.

columns.name: EventCurrencyType
columns.description: COALESCE(Event.EventCurrencyType, Kennel.DefaultEventCurrencyType) — currency code (e.g. 'USD'). NULL when neither is set.

columns.name: Hares
columns.description: HC.Event.Hares — free-text hare names. Table column is NVARCHAR(2500) NULL.

columns.name: LocationStreet
columns.description: HC.Event.SyncLocationStreet — computed column (LocationStreet or FbLocationStreet depending on UseFbLocation).

columns.name: Latitude
columns.description: HC.Event.SyncLatitude — computed column (Latitude or FbLatitude depending on UseFbLatLon). Table column type DECIMAL(18,15) NULL.

columns.name: Longitude
columns.description: HC.Event.SyncLongitude — computed column. Table column type DECIMAL(19,15) NULL.

columns.name: EventDescription
columns.description: HC.Event.SyncDescription — EventDescription or FbEventDescription depending on UseFbRunDetails (the generic import mirror).

columns.name: EventImage
columns.description: HC.Event.EventImage — URL of the event image. NULL when not set.

columns.name: Tags1
columns.description: HC.Event.Tags1 — raw bitflag integer for event tags set 1. Decoded client-side.

columns.name: Tags2
columns.description: HC.Event.Tags2 — raw bitflag integer for event tags set 2. Decoded client-side.

columns.name: Tags3
columns.description: HC.Event.Tags3 — raw bitflag integer for event tags set 3. Decoded client-side.

columns.name: IsCountedRun
columns.description: HC.Event.IsCountedRun — whether this run counts toward run totals. SMALLINT NOT NULL.

columns.name: MyNotificationPref
columns.description: HEM.EventNotificationPreference: 0 auto 1 on 2 ignore 3 mute 4 before run

columns.name: IsMember
columns.description: 1 when the caller's HasherKennelMap.MembershipExpirationDate >= now — the membership rule.

columns.name: IsPast
columns.description: 1 when EventStartDatetimeGmt is more than 6 hours ago (the app's split).

columns.name: GoingCount
columns.description: COUNT of HasherEventMap rows for the run with RsvpState = 3 OR AttendenceState >= 20.

columns.name: DistanceUnitsPref
columns.description: COALESCE(Kennel.DistancePreference, Country.DistancePreference, 0) — the KENNEL's unit; bit 0 set = miles.

columns.name: HasherPreferences
columns.description: COALESCE(HC.Hasher.Preferences, 0) of the caller — bits 0x03 pick the unit for 'runs within N', bits 0x3C >> 2 index the radius ladder 0/10/25/50/75/100/150/200. Same on every row.

columns.name: EventGeographicScope
columns.description: HC.Event.EventGeographicScope — 1 normal run … 7 other special event.

columns.name: EventType
columns.description: HC.Event.EventType — persisted computed text for the scope ('Normal run', …, 'Not specified').

sideEffects: INSERT HC.ErrorLog then THROW in the CATCH.

codeSmells.detail: @deviceId and @accessToken have no SQL default (lines 2-3). A caller that omits one is refused by SQL Server before the procedure runs — an empty 500 with no HC.ErrorLog row (CLAUDE.md 'SP parameter with NO default'). The Next.js client always sends them, so this is latent.

codeSmells.issue: Going-count rule as a naked literal
codeSmells.detail: Line 103 counts going as RsvpState = 3 OR AttendenceState >= 20, a rule the app also holds; CLAUDE.md asks for a rule both sides need to live in one object (view / inline TVF). It is also a correlated COUNT per returned row.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
